title: Ice, water and steam
examples: What is the difference between water and steam?
Can you show me what happens when ice gets warm?
How do we change water into a gas?

explain.say: Today we learn about water in three forms. These forms are solid, liquid, and gas.
When water is solid, it is called ice. Ice keeps its shape no matter what. A block of ice is a good example.
When water is liquid, it is what we usually drink. It takes the shape of whatever container it is in. A puddle is a good example.
When water is a gas, we call it steam. Steam floats up into the air. A cloud is like steam in the sky.
Melting is when a solid turns into a liquid. Ice melting into water is a perfect example of this change.
Boiling is when a liquid turns into a gas. Water boiling on a stove makes steam. This is a big change.

faq.q: If ice melts, does it become steam right away?
faq.a: No, first the ice must melt into liquid water. Then the water can heat up to become steam.
asks: What happens when ice gets warm?
Does melting mean it turns to gas?

faq.q: Is steam the same as water vapor?
faq.a: Steam is visible water vapor, which is the gas form of water. They are related but steam is what we usually see.
asks: What is water as a gas?

faq.q: What causes the change from solid to liquid?
faq.a: Heat energy causes the solid ice to absorb energy. This energy makes the ice particles move faster and break apart into liquid water.
asks: Do I need heat to change ice?

faq.q: Does boiling always happen at the same temperature?
faq.a: For pure water, it boils at one specific temperature. This is a fixed point for water changing from liquid to gas.
asks: At what temperature does water boil?
Is the boiling temperature always the same?

faq.q: Can water change from gas back to liquid?
faq.a: Yes, this is called condensation. When steam cools down, it turns back into liquid water. Think of dew on grass.
asks: What is the opposite of boiling?

facts: Water can exist as a solid, a liquid, or a gas.
Melting is the change from solid to liquid.
Boiling is the change from liquid to gas.
Ice is the solid form of water.

quiz.say: What is the gas form of water?
quiz.why: Steam is the name we use for water in its gas state.

wrong.0: Ice is the solid form, not the gas form.
wrong.1: Liquid is the middle state, like water we drink.
wrong.2: A puddle is just a collection of liquid water.

quiz.say: When ice melts, what state of matter does it become?
quiz.why: Melting is the process where solid ice turns into liquid water.

wrong.0: If it stayed solid, it would still be ice.
wrong.1: Turning to gas is called boiling, not melting.
wrong.2: Steam is the gas form, which happens after boiling.

quiz.say: Water boiling on a stove changes it from liquid to what?
quiz.why: Boiling is the process where liquid water turns into a gas called steam.

wrong.1: It cannot turn directly into a solid when boiling.
wrong.2: If it stayed liquid, it would not be boiling.
wrong.3: Ice is the solid form, which is the opposite of boiling.
